title: Wire concrete backup MCP command publisher into production server
observed_behavior: Backup MCP tools were registered but production app wiring did not provide BackupCommandPublisher or BackupReadModels, so tools returned dependency errors at runtime.
intended_behavior: The production MCP server publishes signed Nostr backup request events through the control-plane relay publisher and reads backup state from the PostgreSQL backup control-plane repository.

nostr_semantics.publish: Signed Nostr request events are emitted with request kind, d tag idempotency coordinate, scoped tags, and relay publish OK outcomes checked by the RelayPool publisher contract.
nostr_semantics.completion: MCP tools return correlation metadata only; workflow completion remains event-driven via backup result/status/read-model events.
